description: Source code for a Flutter widget representing a TV-optimized login screen with focus management and on-screen keyboard overlay.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the login screen, optimized for TV navigation with focusable tiles and external keyboard overlay.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing focus nodes, input values, and interactions for LoginScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes focus nodes and sets initial focus when the widget is first built.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of focus nodes when the widget is removed.

methods.name: _requestNext
methods.description: Requests focus to move to the next focus node.

methods.name: _requestPrev
methods.description: Requests focus to move to the previous focus node.

methods.name: _triggerLogin
methods.description: Handles login action by navigating to '/home' route.

methods.name: _handleDpadTraversal
methods.description: Handles focus traversal and activation based on DPAD key events.

methods.name: _editValueWithKeyboard
methods.description: Opens an overlay for editing input fields via an on-screen keyboard.

methods.name: _passwordPreview
methods.description: Returns a masked preview string for the password.

methods.name: _focusableTile
methods.description: Builds a focusable ListTile for username and password input, handling focus and activation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the login screen, including focusable tiles, login button, and instructions.
